title: Mekoon logo Sajjad
body:
Sham da zindan raat roan wale imam e Sajad a.s raat pocharn wali bhern Sakina da Janaza
karean lai hathyan rasiyanli bharn da janaza
Ali a.s dheyan da mattam
imam e Sajjad ek qadam cha endan har
<<DIVIDER>>
bibi warn kar ka andi e wa muhammad aa
koi bibi warn kr ka andi wa Ali a.s aa
koi bibi andi Hai
Sajjad Hai Sham made imam e sajjad shame de gali da mor waliyai karean lia
<<DIVIDER>>
hathan te karean li bharn da janaza
imam e sajjad a.s da khon wadhiya Sham de log
imam a.s wale pase dekh ke pai hasdan
has has ka pai akhendan kon ha hathan te kehri sha chai watnda hai
<<DIVIDER>>
imam e Sajjad a.s raat roke anden
meko e logo Sajjad a.s da dil ma moi hoi bharn Chai venda
e gathri nai janaza hai ta han de nal lai wenda
meda Imam e Sajjad Sham de sadar bazar Ch aen log samne ake akhenden kon hai kehnda janaza hathan te hai janaze da na aya
<<DIVIDER>>
Sayade Sajden a.s da khon wadhiya e imam a.s raat roke anden
Mosafir haa madina da ma ta itni gareebi a
kafan di ja Sakina s.a kon oha chola pavai venda
Gareban wala kabrostan imam e sajjad a.s bhern ko kabar ch laha ya hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kabar cho do choren choren hath bahir ae hole hole
Awaz ae a Sajjad a.s bhern da janaza meko da ma Akbar a.s hn
Akbar a.s da naam aya meda imam da khon wadhiya
Akbar a.
<<DIVIDER>>
s da warn aya hai Sajjad bhern da kafan kon pya ronda en nh Akbar a.
s bhern diya qadan ko pya ronda en nh Akbar a.
s watan Yad aya Syed a.
s akhenda nai
<<DIVIDER>>
Akbar a.s Akbar a.s da Awaz aya ta kehri Galh ko paya rondain
bhern da maiyat Akbar a.s de hathan te rakh ke saiyade sajden a.s akhendan
Koi kade jai marvadya onda zevar lahai vendan unha rasiyan ta kariyan nal bhern aprin Sumhai wenda
bhern di kabar barai
<<DIVIDER>>
imam e Sajjad a.
s bhern thi kabar de sarandi bah kar kohn pa rondan Saiyad Akhndai Bakir a.
s nal ko 1545 meal parch madad nh mangi Syed Andan Meri madad
kar meda nal phophi di kabar da nishan mitva imam e Muhammad e bakir ams Akhendan q baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Syed roka pai akhendai
khuda wanda gavah rahoven rahe a dardi Shimir laen lo matan enkon oa Mare nishane da mitai wenda
Meko logo Sajjad a.s da ghinar Ma Moi hoi bharn chai venda muhammade bakirul holom medi Sairn
Sakina s.a de kabar ta beth gain pyo putran irada keta hai ral ke medi
<<DIVIDER>>
Sairn s.a di kabar de nishan mitaven jerevala nishan mitavarn Da irada keta Medi Sairn s.a di kabar hal gai a Syed akhendai
Sakina s.a kabar chon be aram q hai Bibi andi a Sajad a.s 1500 meal roli an kogh nh mangiya
Syed akhendai Sakina s.a mang me devan un vela medi Sairn s.a Andea Sham de bazar ch marenda rahen ma kugh nh mangiya
bibi andi ai unha ota tora yati jitha oth nahan tor saghnda bibi s.a andi a Sajjad a.s dekh meda gal zakhmi hn
<<DIVIDER>>
meda galh zakhmi hn meda par zakhmi hn
Syed a.s ahendai mang me devan aj bhi me Sajjad a.s han
jadhan akhyain kugh man me devan
medi Sairn s.a Sakina di kabar Hali hai roka pai akhendi a pori raat kugh nh mangiya
<<DIVIDER>>
hik bhern di minat la Shayal tera baqir jeva o jehri galh meri Sairn s.
a keti a ihyo ja galh medi Sairn s.
a pai keti a dohain peyo potar medi Sairn Sakina di kabar te Jharn paien jharn di hoi jarn te roka pai farmiandaen chal khabar he na hoi t to was posan Syed Akhendan a.
s mang kya mangdi hn kabar chon medi
<<DIVIDER>>
Sairn di eh chez nikli a phir ake roka medi Sairn s.a farmaya
meko Sham gareban Mil pova Mil povaa chola ×2 Asgar da o medi Kabar de vich ta rakh chori meda sehra venda asghar ×2
mehshar tain ma chumdi rahsan me bharn e minat karendi pai yan
